articles.title: Crypto billionaires bankroll Nigel Farage's pro-crypto party
articles.snippet: Tether-linked billionaire Christopher Harborne and BitMEX co-founder Ben Delo donated $9.4 million to Nigel Farage’s Reform UK in the first quarter.

articles.title: Crypto Billionaires Donate $9.4M to Farage’s Reform UK in Q1
articles.snippet: Tether investor Christopher Harborne and BitMEX co-founder Ben Delo’s outspent Britain's traditional political donors.
